mapper.select: SELECT cj.memberIdx, pr.record_id, pr.rating, pr.goal, pr.assist, pr.yellow, pr.red, pr.own_goal, pr.Match_num, pr.clubJoin_num, TO_CHAR(m.match_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS matchDate FROM Player_Record pr JOIN clubJoin cj ON cj.clubJoin_num = pr.clubJoin_num JOIN match m ON m.match_num = pr.match_num WHERE cj.memberIdx = #{memberIdx} ORDER BY m.match_date DESC
